meta.title: Seller Membership
meta.description: Become a Sarnai seller member and put your products in front of thousands of shoppers.

hero.title: Sell your products on Sarnai
hero.lead: A seller member is a person or business allowed to list products in the Sarnai store and sell directly to thousands of shoppers. Send an application and our team replies within 3 business days.

who.title: Who can join
who.lead: Any person or business that meets the requirements below can become a seller member.
who.item1Text: Hold a company or sole proprietor certificate and be able to issue VAT receipts.
who.item2Text: Products must meet quality standards, be legally sold and come with a return policy.
who.item3Text: Prepare orders within 48 hours and deliver them to our fulfilment centre.

benefits.title: Why sell with Sarnai
benefits.lead: We handle sales, marketing and logistics so you can focus on your products and service.
benefits.item1Text: More than 50,000 visitors discover your products every month.
benefits.item2Text: Next-day delivery in Ulaanbaatar and 2–4 days to the provinces.
benefits.item3Text: We collect QPay, card and bank payments and transfer your earnings.
benefits.item4Text: Free participation in campaigns, banners and email promotions.

steps.title: How to become a member
steps.step1Text: Fill in the form below with your brand and product details.
steps.step2Text: Our team contacts you within 3 business days to confirm the details.
steps.step3Text: Once terms are agreed, we sign the contract and create your store account.
steps.step4Text: Add your products and start receiving orders.

fees.title: Fees and payments
fees.payoutNote: Transferred to your bank account every Thursday.
fees.listingNote: No extra fee for your first 30 products.
fees.note: The buyer pays delivery fees. Commission is not charged on refunded orders.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How much does it cost to join?
faq.a1: Registration is free. A 10% commission applies only to completed sales.
faq.a2: Yes. You are responsible for customs clearance and import documents, and must guarantee that products are genuine.
faq.a3: Sarnai arranges delivery. Once you hand the goods to our fulfilment centre, we take responsibility.
faq.a4: Every Thursday we transfer the previous week's sales earnings to your bank account.
faq.a5: Buyers may return products within 14 days. Return costs are settled according to the contract.
